# Playground

> > Playground offers free, customizable design templates for holidays, celebrations, and social media content across diverse cultural events and occasions.

Playground provides a comprehensive library of customizable templates spanning major holidays and celebrations including Chinese New Year, Holi, Diwali, Easter, Christmas, and Janmashtami. The platform specializes in design resources for greeting cards, social media posts, merchandise, and celebration graphics that users can personalize for their needs.

## Key Topics

- Customizable templates
- Design templates
- Greeting cards
- Social media posts
- Floral designs
- Holiday templates
- Chinese New Year
- Holi
- Diwali
- Christmas
- Easter
- Celebration graphics
- Free resources
- Background design
- T-shirt designs

## Festival & Holiday Templates

- [New Year Templates](https://playground.com/templates/s/new-year): New Year and Chinese New Year customizable templates for celebrations and greetings
- [Holi Festival Templates](https://playground.com/templates/s/happy-holi): Holi festival customizable templates for greetings and invitations
- [Floral Background Templates](https://playground.com/templates/s/floral-background): Customizable floral background templates for design projects and celebrations

## Sports & Merchandise Templates

- [Football Templates](https://playground.com/templates/s/football): Football sports templates for merchandise and social media content
